profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Results driven software professional with experiences on various parts of software engineering projects including user application and low level software development on PC, handheld devices, and embedded software. Have solid background on open source software adaptation and excellent understanding on mobile platforms.

Skills:
 Software architect experience - design high level architectural big picture and analyzing open source software
 Experience leading a team of engineers
 17+ years of experience using and developing Linux OS
 Software design and development skills on Linux platform including layers from kernel to application.
 Ability to read hardware schematics to develop software.
 Mobile Linux platform SDK development (Emulator development using QEMU multi-architecture virtualization software)
 Mobile Linux application development (Facebook/Twitter client development using REST/JSON API using Enlightenment GUI SDK.
 Android platform porting on new hardware and Android application development experience.
 Graphics programming using OpenGL ES and libgdx experience.
 Network (TCP/IP, VPN) application and driver development
 Working knowledge on boot loader (u-boot)
 Webkit and Open Office porting for a handheld device.
 Prototyping LAMP server software from the scratch to support low power server board. (Linux, apache webserver, MySQL, PHP, base system libraries and utilities)
 Ability to work on binary data to understand the behavior of software and modify if necessary.
 Excellent debugging skills utilizing GNU gdb/strace.
 Experience using Eclipse and version control systems(git, svn)
 Develop build scripts to automate software delivery to test and release team.
 Programming languages : C/C++/Java and some scripting using python/php/shell.
 Self motivated. Ability to learn and adopt new and existing technologies into solutions.
 Ability to hack the firmware binaries.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading the development of software libraries and applications on FreeRTOS.
Engineered Ethernet (Wiznet W5500) connectivity over SPI, enhancing data communication.
Integrated sensors over I2C, improving system functionality.
Debugged and optimized wireless (802.11ah) connectivity drivers and applications.
Ported AWS IoT Core package, WebSocket, and various Open Source components accelerating development.
Developed a scheduler application utilizing deep sleep for power optimization.
Integrated 802.11ah AP on OpenWRT with Raspberry Pi and NRC SoCs.
Contributed to Newracom's GitHub projects.
positions.insights: Skills: C · FreeRTOS · Wireless Networking · Embedded Linux · C++ · Technical Project Leadership

positions.title: Lead firmware Software Engineer
positions.description:
WeMo (Internet of Things) firmware development project
- Leading embedded IOT software development (switch, sensor, camera, etc)
- Apple Homekit integration in existing IOT device
- https://www.belkin.com/us/Products/smarthome-iot/c/wemo/
- Technology Used.
  * UPNP: service discovery, generic event notification, simple object access protocol
  * rest API
  * MQTT (mosquitto) to communicate with AWSIOT.
  * OpenWRT
  * FreeRTOS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Low power server PoC project
   Develop Android as server including AAMP (Android, apache web server, MySQL, PHP)
   Develop custom Linux platform on ARM server SoC
   Perform Benchmarking to compare ARM based server against x86 servers

 Android mobile office suite development
   Design and develop email client to support Samsung corporate email and office mobility.
   Work with clients (Samsung group) to define requirement and develop inputs into software solution

 Samsung Linux platform connectivity suite development project
   Design and develop suite of applications to support social network including Facebook, Twitter and email client on Samsung Linux platform
   Lead a team of engineers
Develop nand flash emulation for Marvell PXA270 SoC to support ARM emulation

 Samsung Linux platform SDK development project
   Lead a team of engineers to develop mobile SDK for Samsung Electronics
   Mobile SDK development – creating emulator based on QEMU for x86 target
   Develop network and telephony connectivity on the emulator
   Develop Nand flash emulation for Marvell PXA270 SoC to support ARM emulation

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Primary responsibilities include design, develop and maintain the “In Flight Entertainment system” software.
• Design and develop Linux Kernel driver for various parts of embedded system.
• Design and develop API’s for easier access to device drivers and simpler maintenances.
• Porting applications between different architectures
• Develop the cross compile environment for different processor architectures.
• Mentor junior members to learn and adapt new technologies.
• Research the new technologies to enhance the systems future.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for 2 different products for the software related design and develop.
• Coordinate between hardware engineers and software engineers.
• Test all pieces of the hardware on new seatbox and work with hardware developer to isolate and fix the problems.
• Work on new video capture support for the Via and Nvidia graphic and capture card.
• Port Via graphics driver for new Linux kernel 2.6.10.
• Port Via graphics driver for the new Xorg 6.8.2.
• Develop video capturing software that utilize the Video for Linux.
• Prepare the X windows to support the new seatbox.
• Design and implement to support any arbitrary static IP configuration on passenger laptop.
• Test and debug the network connectivity and security.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing and debugging IKE (Internet Key Exchange protocol) implementation.
• Implement PKI support in IKE using 3rd party PKI software.
• Developing and debugging SADB implementation.
• Debugging IPSEC.
• Target machine type was Pentium, and PowerPC using Tornado Vxwork tool.
